_comment: Fish species. rarity: common|uncommon|rare|legendary. time: any|day|night|dawn|dusk|twilight. weather: any|rain|clear|fog|storm|snow. habitats: river|lake|rapids|confluence|deep|sea|pool|starwater (empty = any). size in cm, value in coins at base price.

species.name: River Minnow
species.desc: Quick silver slivers that flash in every shallow. Everyone's first catch.

species.name: Silver Dace
species.desc: Bright and restless, happiest where currents meet.

species.name: River Perch
species.desc: Striped like reeds in low sun. Bites readily, fights honestly.

species.name: Willow Tench
species.desc: Olive-gold and unhurried, found under trailing willow branches.

species.name: Blossom Dace
species.desc: Pink-finned; the old folk say it only rises when petals are on the water.

species.name: Golden Carp
species.desc: A lazy glint of gold in still water.

species.name: Moonlit Carp
species.desc: Its scales hold a faint silver light, as if it swallowed the moon's reflection.

species.name: Maple Minnow
species.desc: Rust-red and tiny, schooling under floating leaves.

species.name: Amber Bream
species.desc: Deep-bodied and bronze, a harvest-table favourite.

species.name: Ember Trout
species.desc: Its red flanks seem to glow at sunset.

species.name: Reed Pike
species.desc: An ambusher of the reed beds. Mind the teeth.

species.name: Brown Trout
species.desc: Speckled and wary; rises to the first light.

species.name: Rainbow Trout
species.desc: A streak of colour in clear, cold water.

species.name: Mist Eel
species.desc: Only seems to feed when the valley fills with fog.

species.name: Cloud Trout
species.desc: Pale as low cloud. Anglers climb for days for a glimpse.

species.name: Glacier Char
species.desc: Deep blue on the back, fiery orange beneath.

species.name: Ice Whitefish
species.desc: A cold-water staple, delicious smoked.

species.name: Crystal Grayling
species.desc: Its sail-like fin is almost transparent, like thin glass.

species.name: Frost Salmon
species.desc: Leaps the icy rapids on its long journey upstream.

species.name: Pine Burbot
species.desc: A bearded bottom-dweller that prefers the dark.

species.name: Ghost Pike
species.desc: Nearly white, nearly silent. Some say it is only a story.

species.name: Jungle Tetra
species.desc: A neon flicker in the tea-coloured shallows.

species.name: Peacock Bass
species.desc: Bold patterns and a bolder temper.

species.name: Silver Arowana
species.desc: Leaps clear of the water to snatch insects from low branches.

species.name: Whiskered Catfish
species.desc: Feels its way along the bottom with long whiskers.

species.name: Bamboo Loach
species.desc: Wriggles out from the roots whenever the rain drums the water.

species.name: Rain Gourami
species.desc: Blushes blue and violet during downpours.

species.name: Lotus Koi
species.desc: White and vermilion, drifting beneath lotus pads.

species.name: Mudskipper
species.desc: A fish that would rather be walking.

species.name: Bog Bowfin
species.desc: An old design of fish, unchanged since the river was young.

species.name: Lantern Eel
species.desc: Glowing spots run down its length like a string of tiny lanterns.

species.name: Canyon Chub
species.desc: Sturdy little fish of warm, fast water.

species.name: Red Shiner
species.desc: Turns the colour of the canyon walls at sunset.

species.name: Sandstone Sturgeon
species.desc: Armoured and ancient, it can live longer than a village.

species.name: Mangrove Snapper
species.desc: Hides among mangrove roots and darts out for a meal.

species.name: Tidal Mullet
species.desc: Travels in and out with the tide in great silver shoals.

species.name: Sea Bass
species.desc: Hunts the surf line as the light fades.

species.name: Silver Tarpon
species.desc: Great mirrored scales and acrobatic leaps.

species.name: Star Koi
species.desc: Its pattern matches no constellation you know. Yet.

species.name: Lumen Ray
species.desc: A soft glowing kite gliding over the bright lake bed.

species.name: Sunscale
species.desc: Said to surface only in the golden hour, when the whole river turns to fire.

species.name: Old Whiskers
species.desc: The river king. Every settlement tells a different story of the one that got away.
